brief:
A Palestinian American activist was refused entry to the United Kingdom to attend his charity's annual Gaza fundraiser, Al Jazeera English reported. The activist had planned to participate in the event organized by his organization.

No reason for the refusal was detailed in the report. The incident raises questions about border policies affecting activism and charitable work related to Gaza.
dek: A Palestinian American activist has been refused entry to the UK to attend his charity’s annual Gaza fundraiser.
title: UK bars Palestinian American activist from Gaza fundraiser
